## FX use case and problem
Describe the research workflow and what currently prevents it.

## Proposed behavior
Give an API/code example and explain expected execution or result semantics.

## Environment and representative data
- backtestingfx and Python versions; OS/architecture:
- Instrument, timeframe, row count, column/index types, and timestamp timezone/unit:
- Relevant sizing, costs, conversion, or order assumptions:

## Current workaround
Include a small example of the current workflow if possible, and alternatives
you considered.

## Acceptance criteria
List observable outcomes and edge cases that would make the feature complete.
Explain how the behavior could be tested with synthetic data.

## Compatibility and scope
Could existing strategies or results change? Note any related
[roadmap](https://github.com/KhizarImran/backtestingfx/blob/main/ROADMAP.md)
items or issues.
